title: Mystical Beasts: The Holy Forest (lore build)
summary: The Mystical Beasts of the Forest ("Holy Beasts of the Forest" in Japanese) are EARTH Beasts with plants growing on them. The page calls them a package, not a deck. This list keeps them together with the only other card of their forest: Eco, Mystical Spirit of the Forest, which Carpiponica can search, and which came out in the same set as Uniflora. In the Extra Deck they climb to Leo, the Keeper of the Sacred Tree, the forest beast the page names as Uniflora's best target.

summary.title: Who's in it, and why
points: All seven Mystical Beasts, led by Cerynemesia (2026) and Kittytail (2023).
Eco, Mystical Spirit of the Forest: the forest's spirit, released with Uniflora (2012).
Extra Deck: Leo, the Keeper of the Sacred Tree, and Number 64: Ronin Raccoon Sandayu for their Level 2s.

summary.title: How it plays
points: Cerynemesia banishes a Beast until the End Phase to summon an EARTH Beast of equal or lower Level from the Deck or GY.
Kalantosa destroys a card whenever a Beast's effect summons it. Valerifawn and Uniflora do the summoning, from the GY and the hand.
Kittytail mills a matching monster and searches when the opponent destroys it. Carpiponica searches another Mystical Beast or Eco.
Valerifawn is the Tuner: Alpacaribou plus Valerifawn and Uniflora make Leo, the Keeper of the Sacred Tree.

main: Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest

Uniflora, Mystical Beast of the Forest

Alpacaribou, Mystical Beast of the Forest

Eco, Mystical Spirit of the Forest
The forest's spirit: reflects effect damage when it summons itself.
extra: Leo, the Keeper of the Sacred Tree
Level 10 Beast Synchro of the Divine Tree; hard to target.
Rank 2 from two Level 2 Beasts: copies the biggest ATK as a token.
Rank 2: searches a Melffy card on summon and negates and prevents attacks from a monster when another Melffy returns to hand.
